duplicate_witness.meaning: Row absence alone does not exclude an exact feature copy; a single witness, not a causal estimate of real-data optimism.

limits: Feature groups are exact-copy exclusions, not known producer/batch/time-independent experimental units
Group sampling changes the resampling unit; row counts vary with group sizes, and validation/test metrics remain row weighted
OOB uses fewer, row-dependent trees and supported subsets; do not compare different-prefix OOB MSE as the same set or treat spread as calibrated uncertainty
One seed and one split; prefix selection uses validation, so the reused historical test is descriptive rather than a new blind benchmark
Established bootstrap averaging, not feature-subsampled random forests, causal component isolation, confidence intervals or proof of future performance

oob.meaning: Average only trees that excluded the entire exact feature group; unsupported rows have null predictions. Descriptive, not calibrated uncertainty or guaranteed unbiased error.

protocol.OOB: Exclude the entire exact feature group. Supported-subset row-weighted MSE; zero votes -> null, not a zero prediction.
protocol.prediction: Unweighted average of tree predictions; no feature subsampling, no pruning, not a random forest
protocol.sampling: Draw G fitting-feature groups G times with replacement per tree; include every original row of every drawn group, repeated for multiplicity
protocol.selection: Minimum validation MSE, exact ties prefer smaller prefix; no OOB or test selection
